newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SPC appoints Rinck as executive director.
newsitem.headline: SPC appoints Rinck as executive director.

text.p: Singapore Petroleum Company Ltd (SPC) said on Monday, it has appointed its executive president, Jacobus Johannes Rinck as its executive director.
Rinck, 60, was also appointed director of Singapore Refining Company Pte Ltd (SRC) as of March 27, SPC said in a statement.

SRC has a 285,000-barrel-per-day oil refinery at Pulau Merlimau, an island off southwestern Singapore, which is co-owned by SPC, with a 40-percent stake, and the remainder equally divided between British Petroleum and Caltex, a joint-venture between Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.
Rinck was previously SRC's general manager and chief executive officer.
